title: Compare Periods Request
description: Compares financial activity between two equivalent time windows: inflow, outflow, net flow and transaction count, with percentage change and insights. Incomplete windows are flagged, never silently compared. Free (fair-use rate limits apply).

chain.description: Blockchain. Celo today; more EVM chains planned.

current_period.description: Period being evaluated: a named period (30d), a month (2026-10) or an explicit range (YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD).

previous_period.description: Period to compare against, same formats as current_period.

metrics.description: Metrics to compare. Defaults to all supported metrics.
